professionalSummary: Software engineer with four years of experience on a warehouse control system team, implementing and testing control system changes in accordance with operations specifications and the team’s software standard.
Demonstrated ability to manage the full change lifecycle, from development through emulation rig testing, software review, release approval, to post‑deployment support and documentation.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the role.

evidence.text: Software engineer on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company for four years, implementing control system changes against the operations specialists' specifications under the team's software standard; forty-four changes in the period, each on a change record in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of implementation against specifications.

evidence.text: Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.
evidence.notes: Explicit mention of emulation rig testing and documented test record.

evidence.text: Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the control system lead's, recorded on the change record.
evidence.notes: Clear reference to software review process and lead approval.

evidence.text: Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents I diagnosed and which were passed to the automation vendor.
evidence.notes: Direct support activity and incident recording.

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.
evidence.notes: Explicit documentation of limitations and hand‑over.

supportedClaims.claim: Implemented 44 control system changes over four years in accordance with operations specifications and the team’s software standard.
supportedClaims.witness: Software engineer on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company for four years, implementing control system changes against the operations specialists' specifications under the team's software standard; forty-four changes in the period, each on a change record in my name.

supportedClaims.claim: Tested each change on the emulation rig with a documented test record and a second engineer’s check.
supportedClaims.witness: Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.

supportedClaims.claim: Took each change through the software review process with release approval by the control system lead.
supportedClaims.witness: Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the control system lead's, recorded on the change record.

supportedClaims.claim: Supported three distribution centres’ support desks with diagnostics, recording incidents diagnosed and those passed to the automation vendor.
supportedClaims.witness: Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents I diagnosed and which were passed to the automation vendor.

supportedClaims.claim: Documented limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each change in the change record’s closure section.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.
